# vesper-prism-h3 test fixtures

* `test-ca.der`, `server.der`, `server.key.der`: copies of the Warp test PKI
  (`crates/vesper-warp/tests/fixtures`, generated by its `gen.sh`). Test-only
  keys; the server certificate names `warp.test`.
* `qifs/`: a subset of the QPACK offline-interop corpus,
  <https://github.com/qpackers/qifs>, fetched 2026-11-13 from the `master`
  branch through `raw.githubusercontent.com` (the GitHub API was not
  reachable from the build host, so the commit SHA could not be read; the
  files are identified by SHA-256 below). It holds `qifs/netbsd.qif` and every
  `encoded/qpack-05/<encoder>/netbsd.out.<capacity>.<blocked>.<ack>` file the
  corpus publishes for six encoders (f5, ls-qpack, nghttp3, proxygen,
  qthingey, quinn): 70 files, 180 KB. The full corpus (also `fb-req` and
  `fb-resp`, 210 files, 24 MB) is checked when `VESPER_QIFS_DIR` points at a
  directory with the same layout.

  | File | SHA-256 |
  | --- | --- |
  | `qifs/netbsd.qif` | `5a09b7cd4b0ce902a8b4e141ea9e0e4a1e0f9891ebef72e8dcd9505198916ec3` |
  | `qifs/fb-req.qif` (not committed) | `75b501df8290c6615b0e626527c64ccf19c53c813c52e841004e558db947642b` |
  | `qifs/fb-resp.qif` (not committed) | `698d06cdfa85fc34d9044ff5c2ef800ac2c1993c3ea7bae589992ed4f209f612` |

* `gen_tables.py`: regenerates `src/qpack/static_table.rs` from RFC 9204's
  Markdown source (`rfc9204.md` in github.com/quicwg/base-drafts, `main`) and
  `src/qpack/huffman_table.rs` from the `h2` 0.4.12 crate's
  `src/hpack/huffman/table.rs` (RFC 7541 Appendix B).
